lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué buscas? A riddle: what has—oh, a leaf. Just one more lap. Five more minutes. Your attention span? Whole vibe.
lines.translation: Hello! What are you looking for? A riddle: what has—oh, a leaf. Just one more lap. Five more minutes. Your attention span? Whole vibe.
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with no particular ambition. Flick flickers at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker pops where he ought to be.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! Pero sigo en movimiento. You got me looking, not stopping. Attention span: enthusiastic leaf. ¿Qué quieres que haga? A riddle: what never—oh, another leaf.
lines.translation: Yes, I’m looking! But I’m still moving. You got me looking, not stopping. Attention span: enthusiastic leaf. What do you want me to do? A riddle: what never—oh, another leaf.
lines.narrative: Flick darts toward the thing you indicated, then past it. A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Looking has apparently become a transport policy.

lines.native: ¡Vale, estoy quieto! Pero ¿adónde voy? What has two paths and—wait, moving dust. Your stopping skills: ten out of ten. ¿Por dónde seguimos?
lines.translation: Okay, I’m standing still! But where do I go? What has two paths and—wait, moving dust. Your stopping skills: ten out of ten. Which way do we go?
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues on without him, apparently lacking supervision.

lines.native: ¿Una pista? En español, por favor. ¿Por dónde voy? A riddle: what has two paths and—ooh, smoke. English directions? Not counted. Five more minutes?
lines.translation: A hint? In Spanish, please. Which way do I go? A riddle: what has two paths and—ooh, smoke. English directions? Not counted. Five more minutes?
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fork. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! Muy bien. Pero primero, un descanso. Podemos seguir mañana. Direction skills: ten out of ten. A riddle: when is—oh, dust. ¿Cuándo quieres seguir? Five more minutes?
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Very good. But first, a rest. We can continue tomorrow. Direction skills: ten out of ten. A riddle: when is—oh, dust. When do you want to continue? Five more minutes?
lines.narrative: Flick veers left, just outside your vision. A tiny firecracker announces that progress has been postponed for administrative reasons.

lines.native: ¡Mañana! Sí, podemos esperar. Procrastination: ten out of ten. Pero tú quieres seguir, ¿no? ¿Cuándo? A riddle: what never arrives—oh, a moth.
lines.translation: Tomorrow! Yes, we can wait. Procrastination: ten out of ten. But you want to continue, don't you? When? A riddle: what never arrives—oh, a moth.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is elsewhere, having been distracted by its own fuse.

lines.native: ¡Ahora! Sí, muy bien. No mañana. Vamos a la izquierda, ahora. Has ganado. Your timing: ten out of ten. Una adivinanza: ¿qué tiene alas y—? ¡Espera, una polilla! Just one more.
lines.translation: Now! Yes, very good. Not tomorrow. Let's go left, now. You've won. Your timing: ten out of ten. A riddle: what has wings and—? Wait, a moth! Just one more.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at your heel. Flick stops postponing for one historic second, then follows a moth to the left. Progress accepts this compromise.
